name: Jehoahaz
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria and did evil, following the sins of Jeroboam.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: Jehoahaz was left with only fifty horsemen, ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen, for Syria had destroyed the rest and made them like dust.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers and Joash his son reigned in his place.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Jehoahaz of Israel
cases.charge: Doing evil in the sight of the Lord and following the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, departing not therefrom; beseeching the Lord under the oppression of Syria, and not departing from the sins of the house of Jeroboam when the saviour came
cases.preview: Jehu’s son Jehoahaz reigned seventeen years in Samaria and kept Jeroboam’s sins, and the Lord gave Israel into the hand of Hazael and his son Ben-hadad all his days (2 Kings 13:1-3).
